title.en: Make real-user QA the release authority
title.zh: 以真实用户验收作为发布标准

purpose.en: Replace synthetic learning claims with signed-in Chrome acceptance and repair the course-detail failure discovered by the real QA learner.
purpose.zh: 停止把合成记录当作学习通过，改用 Chrome 真实登录验收，并修复真实测试账号发现的课程详情故障。

en: Run the 21-day acceptance with one real Chinese-interface learner across English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian.
Require Course five-skill learning, Learn through play, and Everyday Speaking for every selected language.
Fix signed-in course details that remained on an endless loading state because the API queried the wrong course-classroom column.
zh: 21 天验收使用一个中文界面真实测试账号，覆盖英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语。
每种所选语言必须完成课程五项学习、边玩边学和生活口语三组验收。
修复登录后课程详情因 API 查询错误课程教室列而永久停留在加载状态的问题。
本机凌晨 3 点 QA 恢复任务

en: Use smartlingo_course_classrooms.course_id consistently for detail and course-update authorization queries.
Display a visible API error during course-detail loading instead of leaving an unexplained spinner.
Restrict GitHub Actions to anonymous route preflight artifacts and prohibit database or Project learning writes from those checks.
Make the local Codex task reuse or establish a real Clerk session through Gmail and Chrome, repair defects, deploy, and retest from the failed step.
zh: 课程详情和课程更新权限查询统一使用 smartlingo_course_classrooms.course_id。
课程详情加载失败时显示明确接口错误，不再无提示地永久等待。
GitHub Actions 仅生成匿名路由前置检查产物，禁止由此写入学习数据库或 Project 通过记录。
本机 Codex 任务通过 Gmail 与 Chrome 复用或建立真实 Clerk 会话，自动修复、发布并从失败步骤重测。

en: Regression contracts verify the deployed course-classroom schema, visible loading errors, route-only cloud workflow, and real-account QA requirements.
The real QA learner reproduced the production course-detail failure before the fix; production retesting continues after deployment.
Full repository release gates and shared multi-site policy gates must pass before deployment.
zh: 回归契约验证已部署课程教室表结构、可见加载错误、仅路由云端工作流和真实账号 QA 要求。
真实 QA 学员已在修复前复现生产课程详情故障；发布后继续完成生产重测。
部署前必须通过仓库全量发布门禁与共享多站点策略门禁。

en: Microphone speech scoring remains capability-dependent; the daily report must mark an unavailable browser or permission as blocked, never passed.
zh: 麦克风发音评分仍取决于浏览器能力和权限；不可用时日报必须标记为阻塞，不能标记通过。

en: This release changes SmartLingo learning QA and its course-detail schema use only; it does not alter other portfolio sites.
zh: 本次发布仅调整 SmartLingo 学习 QA 与课程详情表结构使用，不改变其他站点。
